examples.solution_text:
$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}\\&=|\underset{\sim}{a}||\underset{\sim}{b}|\cos135^{\circ}\\&=(9)(2\sqrt{2})\left(-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}\right)\\&=-18\end{aligned}$

The tail-to-tail angle is obtuse, so the dot product is negative.

examples.question_text: Two vectors have magnitudes $8$ and $5$. The angle between them is $47^{\circ}$. Find their dot product, correct to two decimal places.

examples.solution_text:
(a) Same direction gives $\theta=0^{\circ}$.

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\underset{\sim}{p}\cdot\underset{\sim}{q}\\&=(4)(9)\cos0^{\circ}\\&=36\end{aligned}$

(b) Opposite directions gives $\theta=180^{\circ}$.

$\begin{aligned}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}\underset{\sim}{p}\cdot\underset{\sim}{q}\\&=(4)(9)\cos180^{\circ}\\&=-36\end{aligned}$

examples.question_text: Two non-zero vectors satisfy $\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}=-21\sqrt{3}$ and $|\underset{\sim}{b}|=7$. The angle between them is $150^{\circ}$. Find $|\underset{\sim}{a}|$.
Two non-zero vectors satisfy $|\underset{\sim}{u}|=7$, $|\underset{\sim}{v}|=10$ and $\underset{\sim}{u}\cdot\underset{\sim}{v}=-35$. Find the angle between them.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{aligned}\cos\theta&=\frac{\underset{\sim}{u}\cdot\underset{\sim}{v}}{|\underset{\sim}{u}||\underset{\sim}{v}|}\\\cos\theta&=\frac{-35}{(7)(10)}\\\cos\theta&=-\frac{1}{2}\\\theta&=120^{\circ}\end{aligned}$

The angle between vectors lies between $0^{\circ}$ and $180^{\circ}$.
